analysis: The closest option integrates Python, data manipulation, databases, machine learning, neural networks and software engineering with cognition, language and human-centred design. C++ and Haskell development gives real software-construction depth. Robotics adds kinematics, manipulation and motion planning. Perception, cognition and product design develop complementary ways to study systems and users. Psycholinguistics has one planned offering and follows Introduction to Brain & Behavior in the first year. Its empirical study of speech and language is substantive, while the comparator teaches computational speech and language processing.

The law option responds to the explicit Law and IT elective direction with public, private, EU, constitutional and international law plus a policy analysis course. Python, databases, networks, algorithms and machine learning give the option technical substance. AI Ethics addresses privacy, fairness and accountability. The law courses provide tools for reasoning about technology and institutions, without claiming a specialist data-protection or technology law course.

The business option responds to the explicit business direction. Marketing, market research, digital transformation, AI business applications and organisational psychology combine with software, databases and machine learning. These courses add specific organisational, consumer and data applications, while preserving meaningful computing depth. Consumer Product Design is retained in the closest option for user needs and prototypes and is replaced in the business option by Marketing & Consumer Engagement.

The alternatives differ by 75, 52.5 and 60 EC each way. The closest option is strongest across technical, language and human-centred themes. Law adds institutions and legal reasoning, and business adds organisational and consumer applications. Further technical, linguistic and communication directions were considered. AI and language are materially represented in the closest composition. The explicit elective themes do not justify exceeding the three-option limit.

Database design, programming, statistical analysis, data manipulation and machine learning have direct partial counterparts. Stylistics and user-centred product design share relevant foundations with linguistic analysis and usability, while their applied domains differ. Robotics does not teach the comparator’s spoken-interaction and evaluation sequence. General search and AI optimisation cannot substitute for dedicated retrieval, information theory or co-creation with generative models. The separate required project and thesis stay visible.
constructionStop: Three academically viable and distinct compositions meet the maximum.

HCBCOGN312.contribution: Examines the production, comprehension and acquisition of language through experimental psycholinguistics.
HCBCOGN312.topics: Psycholinguistics is the study of the neurobiological and psychological factors that enable us to acquire, use, and understand language. Modern research draws on cognitive psychology, neuroscience, and computer science to investigate how language is processed. The course focuses primarily, though not exclusively, on the neuroscience of language. Students examine theoretical and experimental issues in speech production and comprehension, language impairments, the relationship between thought and language, and the evolution and acquisition of language. They also gain hands-on experience with experimental approaches to the study of language and develop an understanding of human linguistic capacity as a subject of multidisciplinary research. Topics covered: What is language? Evolutionary aspects of language and animal communication; language and thought; aphasia; language acquisition; bilingualism; speech comprehension; semantics; reading and dyslexia; speech production.

alignment.rationale: Both teach relational database design and SQL. Groningen also develops database-driven web applications.
Both teach data cleaning and manipulation. UCR also introduces data visualisation.
Both teach machine-learning methods and model evaluation.
Both study neural networks and text applications. Groningen gives dedicated attention to language models and translation.
Both introduce programming and computational problem solving.
The selected UCR courses cover parts of information science. Groningen introduces it as a discipline.
UCR covers software and databases. Groningen teaches web development as a separate subject.
UCR algorithms and optimisation teach general search methods. Groningen studies search engines and information retrieval.
UCR logic, mathematics and data science supply foundations. Groningen separately studies information measures and encoding.
UCR studies AI models and optimisation. Groningen separately develops and evaluates work produced through human collaboration with generative AI.
UCR data courses include applied projects. Groningen requires a separate data science project.
Both investigate user needs and develop prototypes. UCR works with consumer products, while Groningen tests computer interfaces.
Both analyse linguistic choices and textual data. UCR focuses on stylistics, while Groningen connects linguistic theory to language technology.
UCR studies social aspects of technology across several subjects. Groningen gives humane AI dedicated interdisciplinary study.
The UCR courses include projects in design, ethics and AI. Groningen integrates these concerns in a dedicated humane AI project.
UCR Psycholinguistics investigates human speech and language. Groningen teaches computational processing of speech and language.
UCR Robotics studies movement, planning and manipulation. Groningen teaches spoken interfaces and evaluation of human-robot interaction.
Both introduce statistical analysis and inference. UCR applies these methods to business and social research.
Both examine ethical questions about technology. UCR focuses on AI, while Groningen covers information technology more broadly.
This is approved elective space.
The Groningen thesis is required. UCR independent research is optional and appears separately.
